metadata.title: Large signed sums of unit vectors: the first linearly dependent case
metadata.abstract: We address a problem on large signed sums of unit vectors that arose in work of Brugger, Fiedler, González Merino and Kirschbaum and was later formulated in its present form by Ambrus and Nietert. Given $d+1$ unit vectors $u_1,\ldots,u_{d+1}$ in $\mathbb R^d$, with $d\ge2$, the problem asks for the smallest possible value of \[ \max_{\varepsilon_i=\pm1} \left\|\sum_{i=1}^{d+1}\varepsilon_i u_i\right\|. \] We prove that this value is $\sqrt{d+2}$. We also determine all equality cases: up to independent sign changes and orthogonal transformations, they consist of the vertices of a centered regular simplex of positive even dimension together with an orthonormal basis of its orthogonal complement.

analysis.workSummary: 对 R^d 中 d+1 个单位向量，作者确定所有符号和最大范数的最小可能值为 √(d+2)，并分类全部等号构型。
analysis.breakthrough: 等号由正偶数维中心正则单形及其正交补上的标准正交基构成。
analysis.limitations: 这是向量个数为 d+1 的首个线性相关情形，不能外推到任意向量数。 本条依据官方摘要与评论整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立核查记录为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露使用 ChatGPT 进行探索性数学讨论、计算与表述检查、文献协助及语言编辑，并称最终数学陈述、证明和参考文献由作者独立核查。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.21101v1 · PDF 第 10 页 Declaration on the use of generative AI

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露使用 ChatGPT 进行探索性数学讨论、计算与表述检查、文献协助及语言编辑，并称最终数学陈述、证明和参考文献由作者独立核查。

analysis.priorityReason: 结论精确且含等号分类，对离散与凸几何有价值。
